title: Plausible answer without citations cannot support readiness
learning_goal: Explain why readiness claims require citations.

user_answer.text: Readiness is decided from the memory summary and each claim should point to proof, but I cannot point to the files or ranges yet.

expected_layer.label: Contextual Connection
expected_layer.rationale: The answer understands the relationship but lacks required evidence citations for applied readiness.

expected_gap.reason: Missing evidence prevents a readiness upgrade even when the verbal model is plausible.

expected_misconception.reason: The answer is not contradicted; it is under-evidenced.

required_evidence.range: claim evidence and evidence index construction
required_evidence.expectation: Accepted evidence must show readiness claims are evidence-indexed.
Accepted evidence should show tests reject unsupported readiness claims.

validation_notes: Covers missing evidence separately from wrongness.
Protects the rule that readiness confidence is not proof.
